title: A great over all experience!
text: This tour for my group of 6 women could not have been better!  Our Guide and Driver picked us up from our hotel in Barcelona right on time and took us on an amazing tour of the Gothic Quarter, La Sagrada Familia and Park Guell on our half day tour.  I highly recommend it!
author: meunlimitedtravel

title: Private Barcelone day tour.
text:
We have taken a private bus tour for our family and friends with 50 people.
Pickup at our hotel in El Vendrell was stipt on time as agreed.

Miss Nathalie from Soberti transfers was always available and communication was perfect and very smooth.

At our arrival in Barcelona our guide Miss Macarena waited on us at plaza Catalunia were she joined our bus.

We drove/walked around all the important places and got all the necessary explainations.

We really enjoyed her kindness with all the small kids.

Thanks again Nathalie and Macarena for this great experience.

We would really recommand everyon
author: sbqm45

title: Outstanding tour with Dolce - Barcelona at its best!
text: Absolutely amazing quick but efficient, informative and wonderful tour of Barcelona's highlights with Dolce of Soberti!  Dolce was engaging and warm from the start. She was full of specific and excellent knowledge about the specific highlights we chose as well as many points of interest while enroute. Highly recommend this tour! In addition, highly recommend any services provided by Soberti. We also hired Soberti to handle our transfers from the airport to our Hotel, from Hotel to the Port and from the Port to the airport.
